📖 How to use

  1. Paste your text.
  2. Stats update automatically.
  3. Check sentence count, average length and the longest sentence.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are sentences detected?

Text is split on . ! ? followed by a space or end of text; common abbreviations like Mr. and Dr. are handled.

Which is the longest sentence?

The longest sentence is shown in full with its word count.

What counts as a word here?

Sequences of letters and digits; hyphenated compounds count as a single word.
